meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 它能翻查你在所有会话里留下的工作记录。先给出一份带编号的搜索结果列表，再按时间线展示相关上下文，选中后才会读取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问“我们之前是不是解决过？”“上次是怎么做某事的？”或需要调用以前会话的工作内容时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修好登录问题的？
say.note: 它会先搜索相关记录再给你提取结论。

say.text: 帮我找一下上周在这个项目里处理过的bug。
say.note: 它会限定项目和时间范围搜索。

say.text: 把上次关于JWT认证的讨论时间线展开。
say.note: 它会围绕那件事显示前后上下文。

howto.what_en: It can search your work records from past sessions. It first returns a list of matching records with IDs, then shows timeline context around selected ones, and only fetches full details for the IDs you choose.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "Did we already solve this?", "How did we do X last time?", or need work from earlier conversations.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login issue last time?
say_en.note: It searches and summarizes relevant records.

say_en.text: Find bugs we handled last week in this project.
say_en.note: It filters by project and date range.

say_en.text: Show the timeline around that JWT auth discussion.
say_en.note: It displays context before and after that event.
